facts.fact: Africaho reports that a DGI circular of 16 September 2025 states that payment and affixing of tax stamps and registration of deeds are done exclusively online through the e-services.impots.bj platform, with an electronic stamp carrying a QR code verifiable on the platform.

BEN.note: The circular covers tax stamps and deed registration only; online filing of returns is not stated.
